scope: Rascunhos autorais durante a revisão. Não são oito formas alternativas concluídas e não substituem os cavaleiros originais. Geração das demais configurações suspensa para atender ao estudo solicitado pelo autor.

attempts.name: geordraco-dragao-generico
attempts.prompt: Create an ALTERNATIVE BEAST-FACED FORM of our attached ORIGINAL armored DRACONIAN SOULMONSTER. Preserve palette, unique weapon, major body architecture and identifiable armor, but the knight now has a fully exposed LIVING MONSTER HEAD instead of a closed helmet. This is a proposed alternate same-stage configuration, NOT evolution or a human unmasking. MOST IMPORTANT: remove the lower knight visor ENTIRELY and expose a mature ANATOMICAL dragon face, integrated skull volume, narrow small organic eyes with iris/pupil, deep brow sockets, defined nostrils, snout bridge, thick upper lip, working jaw hinge, angular cheek ridges and 2-4 visible restrained teeth. NO human mouth/nose/face, skin-colored human beneath helmet, cartoon puppy face, round baby eyes, broad cute smile, robotic metal face or mouth grating. The upper helmet becomes a partial metal crest and cheek/temple guards leaving ALL muzzle and lower jaw visible; real horns grow from skull. Neck and recessed shoulder joints visibly form living taut colored PAPER anatomy with few broad folds, not a muscular human in a suit or wrinkled biological skin. 45% living creature/45% functional living-kite construction/10% crisp dark selective stepped contour and CLEAN 2D MANGA. Keep sculpted dragon-face METAL relief on armor shoulders/chest/knees, distinct from real anatomical head: relief eyes unlit, creature eyes alive. Rich flat saturated colors, TWO HARD cel shadow tones and restrained hard metal highlight stripes; no gloss, gradients, tiny texture noise, 3D painting, random origami triangular mesh or paper confetti. Strong adult beast presence through anatomy/stance, not just adding spikes. ONE rooted soul-rabiola with full cord/terminal, keep separate from cloak and weapon cord. Full body and all equipment entirely inside generous plain WHITE margins, no text, panels, new crystals, written symbols, orange eyes, extra limbs, extra living heads, scenery or secondary creature. BULL-DRAGON head: broad long horn-rooted skull, squared deep muzzle, heavy ivory paper lower jaw, deep-set VIOLET eyes, two short upper fangs just revealed by a controlled warning snarl. EMERALD taut-paper forehead and cheeks with IVORY snout planes, TWO thick backward-curled gold/cream real horns. No beard or human lips. Thick short paper neck exposed between massive armor collar segments. Retain compact stocky two-armed two-legged knight, lance and tall dragonface shield. More bestial hunched-forward stance, four fingers+thumb gauntlets still functional, feet large two-toed dragon claws rather than human boots. Head is a creature, green metal upper crest above brow only; all lower face organic folded paper.
attempts.correction: Targeted correction of OUR green dragon knight. Make the exposed REAL dragon face clearly alive rather than ivory metal mask: forehead, cheeks and upper muzzle become EMERALD GREEN taut matte paper with dark green hard shadows, only the lowerjaw and narrow lip ridge remain ivory paper. REMOVE golden metal outlines from the muzzle and cheek surfaces (keep partial metal green-gold CROWN behind eyes). Show a working open lower jaw at modest 20-degree angle with a dark burgundy mouth cavity, THREE small ivory predatory teeth rooted at gums and thick angular lip, NOT a grinning human mouth or huge cartoon smile. Small VIOLET organic iris + black pupil visible within narrow deep socket, nose nostril cavity and cheek-to-jaw joint readable. Keep horns, exact armor plates and relief dragonfaces, weapon, shield, cape, legs, feet, rabiola, pose and white background unchanged. 2D manga hard cel shading, NO fleshy wrinkles, scales noise, mask rivets or metallic shine on face. Mature powerful reptile, no smiling puppy.

attempts.name: geordraco-estudo-rosto-pipa
attempts.prompt: Design correction for Soulmonsters: an exposed head must itself be a LIVING KITE-CREATURE, not a biological dragon with armor. 45% expressive creature /45% functional paper kite /10% crisp selective stepped outline and flat 2D manga. Our own griffin image demonstrates construction of face from BROAD TAUT PAPER PLANES; only learn that principle, NOT griffin beak/species/blue palette/crystal/wings. Retain our knight body identity from the other image.  Draw a LARGE HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS design study of GEORDRACO in an exposed alternative, one single three-quarter bust on WHITE. Replace the tiny helmet with an authentic monstrous SOULMONSTER face constructed from living paper. Main head silhouette: a broad EMERALD kite-wedge skull stretching forward into a strong squared folded snout; one single sharp center crease from brow to tip, TWO swept-back ivory cheek-VANES made of taut paper, not scales or hair. TWO upper horns are narrow CURVED BAMBOO ARCS carrying thin triangular emerald/ivory PAPER membranes like kite ears, rooted behind temples with two tiny structural gold knots, NOT solid biological horns. Face has only FIVE broad quiet paper masses: brow plane, nose roof, two cheek planes and a LOWER JAW that folds on ONE visible golden paper-joint at rear cheek. Small intense VIOLET manga eyes sit under overhanging paper brows, mature deep sockets and narrow black pupil, not giant eyes or glowing visor. A dark open mouth gap follows the edge of the upper folded snout, with only TWO blunt ivory folded-paper fangs and a strong ivory flap lowerjaw; no fleshy gum/tongue, no rounded reptilian lips, no scales, no human nose or smile, no birdbeak. The face should feel like a mature fierce kite creature, not a robot, metal mask, generic fantasy dragon or cute cardboard toy. ONE slim partial green-gold metal crown rests behind the brow, leaves all face exposed. Neck made of THREE broad overlapping emerald/ivory taut paper collar forms, one bamboo inneredge disappears into existing chest armor. Keep our original emerald/ivory/coral knight armor shoulders with sculpted rigid dragonface reliefs distinct from living face. Do NOT add diamond crystal or copy griffin brow/beak/bluecolors. Expressive compact angular monster anatomy, graceful controlled power, rich colors, ONLY TWO hard cel shadow tones, matte paper and selective stepped dark contour. No written labels, no panel grids, no scene or external character motifs.

attempts.name: geordraco-rosto-pipa
attempts.prompt: Create full body ALTERNATIVE GEORDRACO using our OWN two images: image1 is exact body/armor/weapon/palette identity to PRESERVE, image2 is our new HEAD DESIGN to use faithfully instead of helmet. The living head is a fierce taut-paper dragon with broad emerald upper snout crease, ivory angular cheek/jaw, small violet eyes, open dark mouth with few folded fangs and two curved bamboo-supported ivory/green horn-sails; do NOT revert to biological dragon muzzle or closed visor. Head small adult proportion ~1/8 total standing height; don't enlarge to cartoon. Preserve original TWO arms TWO legs, stocky knight shoulders, tall shield with rigid dragonface relief, forked lance fully held in right hand and one coral braided soul-rabiola; cape and full two clawed feet. Partial green crown stays behind brow; real mouth exposed and expressive, living-paper neck visible. Pose adult poised protecting, no extra heads or limb. Broad paper membranes, few meaningful folds, functional knots and varetas. CLEAN flat 2D manga, hard cel shadows, selective stepped dark contour, matte colors, no realistic skin/fur/scales/muscle or glossy armor. Full body and all equipment uncropped on WHITE with generous margin, no text, panels or external references. Original helmets retained elsewhere, this is a separate same-stage configuration.

Lowerjaw is one expressive flexible folded paper piece with small structural pivot hidden at rear cheek; opening mouth follows paperedge with 2-3 short folded ivory fangs and dark untextured cavity. Small narrow adult manga eye with iris/pupil under paper brow, NOT large cartoon eye, human eye or glowing visor. NO human exposed face, biological scale/lip/gum texture, rounded reptile skin, robotic metal muzzle, closed visor or mask. Partial metal brow crest rests BEHIND living face; real head colorful matte paper, distinct from rigid sculpted METALLIC DRAGON FACE reliefs on armor. Preserve armour but open neckline to reveal 2-3 wide folded living-paper collar pieces. 45% creature 45% pipa 10% crisp dark selective stepped contour/2D manga. Flat saturated colors, TWO hard cel shadow tones, no glossy 3D, gradients, paper confetti, all-over tiny triangles, crystals, patchwork or orange eyes. Full creature AND all equipment wholly within WHITE background margin, no labels or panels. Anatomy and identity instructions follow; translate any old biological terms into our paper-kite construction. RIVER-DRAGON head: long slender wedge snout and low swept cheek fins, small intense MINT-GREEN organic eyes set under deep cobalt brow, ivory/cyan paper jaw with two backward protruding lower-jaw tusk teeth (small, do not become sabers), tight closed snarl on one side. TWO flat blue swept real horns flow backward with turquoise kite ear fins. Not equine humanface, not birdbeak. Long elegant turquoise paper neck, quiet broad folds and cream throat keel. IMPORTANT head NOT square like image2: long thin COBALT folded snout as a narrow central keel, TWO long turquoise lateral swept cheek-sails like river rudders; lowerjaw ivory narrow fold, two short ivory fang folds, small MINT eyes. Horns are flat blue kitefin sails with gold bamboo leading spars, NOT solid animal horns. Preserve the ONE-hand sword grip and EMPTY open otherhand. No new braid.

attempts.name: lacustrel-piloto-paleta
attempts.prompt: PRODUCTION COLOR STRUCTURE REDESIGN of our own Lacustrel paper-dragon knight, keep the exact mature exposed living-kite face, long folded snout/ivory jaw/small pupil, TWO arms TWO legs and pose, sword in right hand only, other open hand, one soul-rabiola, sculpted dragonface shoulders. User wants FAR fewer decorative color transitions and repeatable clean anime model colors. Use THREE MAIN material colors plus ONE TINY accent: (1) DOMINANT COBALT BLUE on ALL outer armor plates, mantle/cape outside, hip coat tails, head crest, sword frame, shoulder dragon reliefs, bracers and greaves; broad contiguous large shapes, ~70% visible area. (2) WARM IVORY on exposed living-paper neck/face lower jaw, upperarm and upperleg gaps, inner cape, bamboo spars and teeth, ~20%. (3) GRAPHITE for deep joint recesses, eye sockets and mouth only, ~8%. (4) MINT eye iris and ONE thin sword tension-line and a couple structural knots only ~2%. REMOVE all GOLD decorative edge borders, metallic SILVER armor fields, TURQUOISE body fields and LILAC lining. Do not replace their many stripes with new blue stripe patterns: ERASE decorative diagonal inlays; chest has ONE uninterrupted cobalt cuirass whose form is shown by two simple hard shadow planes, not white/gold zigzags. Each shoulder dragon relief should be sculpted IN THE SAME BLUE plate, with ONE small pale-blue hard highlight along brow/jaw for material, not separate colored mask. All gauntlets and boots cobalt, neutral recesses. Cape only blue OUTSIDE and ivory INSIDE with no colored edging. Living face top cobalt and lowerjaw ivory, NO biological dragon skin/scales, NO mask visor. Rabiola is ONE solid cobalt cord, two ivory terminal flags, not braided multicolor stripes. Keep few actual bamboo supports in ivory, no outlines of every panel in another color. Anime model-sheet simplicity like strong armor designs, not low detail blob: keep detailed SHAPE and silhouettes, simplify COLOR segmentation. CLEAN FLAT 2D MANGA, ONE base + ONE hard shadow + ONE restrained hard highlight per material, zero gradients/gloss/PBR/paint texture/noise. Plain white background, full uncropped figure and weapon with margins, no text or logos. Anatomy should remain fierce adult pipa-creature, not human or cartoon.
